content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | SFC Environmental Technologies (NSE: SFCTECH) SFC Environmental Technologies reports H1 FY27 financial results ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details (H1 FY27): - Revenue: Rs 2,966.7 Mn (+80.5% YoY) - EBITDA: Rs 200.5 Mn (+86.9% YoY) - PAT: Rs 35.8 Mn (vs Rs 0.4 Mn in H1 FY26) - Order Book: Rs 16,561.7 Mn 📌 What happened: ↳ The company reported strong growth in its first results as a listed entity, driven by its Solid Waste Treatment and Wastewater Treatment segments. The current order book stands at approximately 2.1x of its FY26 revenue. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
